name: Hardware shop
intro: If you sell hardware or building material on credit to contractors and regular buyers, the amounts can be large. BolCash helps you keep each account clear.

uses.title: Contractor and customer accounts
uses.body: Keep the udhar of each contractor or buyer in one place.

uses.title: Supplier dues
uses.body: Keep track of what you owe your suppliers and dealers, and note it when you pay.

uses.title: Daily cash
uses.body: Record the money that comes in and goes out each day.
